text:
Diego M.: Hey team, first day! quick nav Qs: 1) Is clicking the phish-sim email OK or should i just report? 2) My laptop shows FileVault "Off"  can IT enable remotely? 3) Can i use desktop Authy for MFA until YubiKey arrives? 4) Need sandbox KMS for a short pairing session  what's fastest path?

Mira (People Ops): Welcome Diego! :wave: Short answers: report the sim instead of clicking; IT can guide but not force-enable FileVault on personal devices; desktop Authy is allowed briefly; for sandbox KMS, open a ticket with manager approval and note it's time-limited.

IT Helpdesk: @Diego M. If you want, we can schedule a 15m remote walkthrough to enable FileVault on your Mac. Otherwise run `fdesetup enable -user $(whoami)` and paste `fdesetup status` in the ticket. For loaner or rapid YubiKey shipping, request via the loaner/MFA hardware option in the ticket form.

Security Team: Report sims with the "Report Phish" button or forward to phishing@redwood.infra. Clicking a simulated link only records it for training and won't be punitive; if you clicked a real-looking unknown link, disconnect VPN and DM Security. Sandbox KMS: we typically grant `kms:DevSandboxDecrypt` for up to 48h with manager sign-off and completed data-handling acknowledgement. Mention the repo and demo window in the ticket.

Diego M.: thanks all  one small followup: will reporting a sim create a ticket or email flood? want to avoid spamming my manager with notifications.

Security Team: Good question. Reporting triggers an internal signal to Security, not an automated email to your manager. People Ops only sees aggregate anonymized results unless follow-up is needed. We'll only reach out directly if we see repeated risky clicks.

Onboard Bot: Reminder: Security basics quiz due in 6 days. Phishing sim window for new hires: 1769520000 - 1769606400.
